header:
Gas costs $1.23
more than last year

lines.text: Gas jumped $1.23 a gallon in a year.
lines.say: Gas jumped a dollar twenty-three a gallon in a year.

lines.text: AAA national average for regular: $3.14 on Oct 4, 2025, $4.37 on Oct 4, 2026.
lines.say: AAA's average for regular is four dollars and thirty-seven cents, up from three dollars and fourteen cents a year ago.

lines.text: EIA data: September 2026 averaged $4.36 a gallon, the highest September on record.
lines.say: September set a record too, averaging four dollars and thirty-six cents in government data.
That's fifty-two cents more than September twenty twenty-three.

lines.text: Why fuel is up: NPR ties record diesel to the Strait of Hormuz closure amid the war with Iran, plus high refining costs (Sept 21).
lines.say: Why? NPR points to the war with Iran closing oil routes through the Strait of Hormuz, plus pricey refining.

lines.text: Example: a 12-gallon fill-up cost $37.68 a year ago and $52.44 at today's average.
lines.say: For example, a twelve-gallon fill-up now costs about fifteen dollars more than a year ago.

lines.text: Diesel hit a record $6.53 on Sept 22. Trucks that haul groceries and goods run on diesel.
lines.say: Diesel hit a record six dollars and fifty-three cents on September twenty-second, and trucks hauling groceries run on it.

lines.text: Gas is down 11 cents from a week ago. EIA's next energy forecast comes Tuesday, Oct 6.
lines.say: One bright spot: gas is down eleven cents from a week ago, and the government's next fuel forecast lands Tuesday.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.
lines.say: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: Gas jumped $1.23 a gallon in a year. Here's why
post.ig:
Gas jumped $1.23 a gallon in a year.
AAA's national average for regular is $4.37 (Oct 4, 2026), up from $3.14 on Oct 4, 2025.
September 2026 averaged $4.36 (EIA), the highest September on record. That's 52 cents above Sept 2023.
Diesel hit a record $6.53 on Sept 22. Example: a 12-gallon fill-up costs about $15 more than a year ago.
Sources: AAA, EIA, NPR.
